captures.description: THE COMPLETION OF MARX'S IMPLICIT LINGUISTICS: the AI Overview gives the thesis of Mind-Control Poems (#24) to Johannes Sigil and Lee Sharks — language as alienated, not merely practical consciousness; the completion as closing 'the Logotic Loop' — and tabulates it against classical Marxism, its last row '"Phase X": Direct warfare over presentation layers and symbolic loops', a compound of #367, #22 and Autonomous Semantic Warfare (#499).

atoms.evidence: articulated by Johannes Sigil and Lee Sharks in their text
what the authors call the "Logotic Loop."
Sigil and Sharks argue that classical Marxism failed to see that language is itself subject to alienation.
while Karl Marx systematically mapped out how human labor is alienated under capitalism, he left his understanding of language itself largely implicit
